crossRefs.note: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by…
came behind him, and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.
“ ‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days.…
“ ‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
“ ‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond…
Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way…
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made…
For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
